c74object.name: evi_ladder_transistor
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Nonlinear TPT Transistor Ladder filter emulation
c74object.description:
evi_ladder_transistor is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_ladder_transistor.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_tanh.genexpr, evi_interp.genexpr
evi_ladder_transistor is also available in MSP as: evi.ladder.transistor~.
A dirty nonlinear 24dB Transistor Ladder filter emulation. The object provides two FM modulation inlets for the filter cutoff frequency. This filter has been tuned to be quite 'hot' and aggressive compared to the evi.ladder.moog~ object, which may be preferable if a clean sound is required.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ input, cutoff, cutoff, cutoff, resonance } }

geninlet.name: cutoff
geninlet.digest: in Hz or Pitch. Cutoff frequency in Pitch or Hz (default) depending on the @cutoffmode attribute.

geninlet.name: cutoff
geninlet.digest: Pitch Mod @default 0. Logarithmic FM input. Accepts an FM signal which is summed internally with cutoff in pitch prior to Linear FM inlet. This is only active if @cutoffmode attribute == 1, otherwise it is ignored.

geninlet.name: cutoff
geninlet.digest: Hz Mod @default 0. Linear FM input. Accepts an FM signal which is summed internally with cutoff in Hz post Logarithmic FM input. This inlet is always active regardless of the @cutoffmode attribute.

geninlet.name: resonance
geninlet.digest: (0..1..2). Self oscillates at resonance > 0.9 but can take values > 1. High resonance values still work but lose a little tuning accuracy above about 2kHz cutoff.

attribute.name: cutoffmode
attribute.description: Switch cutoff frequency (inlet 2) between Pitch (on) or Hz (default off).

attribute.name: cutoffsmooth
attribute.description: Optionally smooth the cutoff (inlet 2). If audio rate modulating inlet 2 (or potentially with inlets 3 or 4) this should be turned off.

attribute.name: oversample
attribute.description: 2x oversampling if on (default), 1x if off (careful). Oversampling almost doubles the CPU usage.

attribute.name: ressmooth
attribute.description: Optionally smooth the resonance (inlet 5). If audio rate modulating inlet 5 this should be turned off.
